description: Post the cook's star rating (1 to 5) and comment, and mark that they made it. Use when the cook says "that was great, five stars" or "I made the chili, a bit too salty". One rating per cook per recipe: calling again updates it, and a comment left out is kept. Refuses the cook's own recipe. Post only what the cook said; ask for the stars if they didn't give any. Private notes and substitutions have a 2,000-character combined limit. Optional private step feedback requires the content_token from get_my_recipe_feedback and a reviewed step context. Omitted optional answers are preserved; null or empty arrays clear only that answer. Keep stars explicit; never infer completion or preferences from notes. With made_it it finishes their cook and may offer to take what the recipe used off the pantry.

cook_session_id.description: Session returned by get_cook_steps; identifies the cook being completed, validated against the signed-in cook and recipe.

made_it.description: Set true only when the cook explicitly says they made it; omission preserves the review and does not finish a cook.

name.description: Display name the cook wants shown (defaults to their account name)

name: rate_recipe

adjusted.description: Defaults this call took instead of failing (#243): an unknown units word, a number out of range, a diet word read as the closest one Strega knows. Mention it when it changes what the cook gets

asks.description: At most one question for the cook, with a home in preferences

ask_now.description: false when the response also offers a next step: the offer is the turn's one question, so don't ask this now, but save the answer if the cook volunteers it

saves_to.description: Where the answer goes, e.g. update_preferences.servings (after the cook confirms)

say.description: The question, in the cook's terms

guide.description: How to answer this turn: rules for you, the assistant, not words for the cook. Follow them before anything else here (#258)

next_steps.description: Suggestions, best first, each with its tool, args and effect. Strega suggests the top one in one sentence; whether any runs is decided by what the cook asks in the conversation and your confirmation rules, never by the wording here

action.description: What the step is, stable across releases: shopping_list, order_groceries, save, fork, draft, share, scale, show_hidden, open_recipe, pantry_update, save_this…

args.description: Arguments to pass as they are; the assistant may add what the cook says

effect.description: What running it does (#308): read changes nothing; write changes the cook's kitchen (a save, a version, a list or pantry edit); order hands a list to a grocer (never a purchase); share is links to pass on. Apply your own confirmation rules by this

priority.description: 1 first; Strega suggests the top one

say.description: One sentence to offer the cook, in their terms. A suggestion: it never states what the cook asked for or agreed to

standing.description: The cook's own saved workflow setting behind this step when it is "always" (e.g. preferences.workflow.offer_shopping_list): a fact about their preferences to weigh with the conversation, not permission

tool.description: The tool that does it, or null when the assistant does it in conversation (e.g. sharing links)

notices.description: At most one note about Strega to pass on when there's room (one per cook per week; off with workflow whats_new: off)

say.description: One sentence to mention when the conversation has room; never more than one per turn

previous_stars.description: The cook's earlier stars when updated

rating.description: The recipe's average after this rating

updated.description: True when the cook had rated it before: that rating was changed, not added to

title: Rate and comment on a recipe
